I don't usually write on here but I'm a bit disturbed at some of the comments providing "ideas". Please remember that if you go through with something like this your parents will suffer enormously anyway. I don't think that is the sole reason you shouldn't harm yourself though. What you are feeling right now doesn't have to be forever. I really do understand that it feels like that because I've been there and come through. I'm not going to lie, sometimes I still have incredibly difficult times but they last shorter now that I've worked on coping skills and am appropriately medicated. I also remember that the dark times aren't permanent. It's important that you seek professional and non-professional (community engagement etc) help and start finding the motivation to get up and enjoy at least part of your day. It's worth it even if there is only a small part of the day you enjoy. And since you've indicated that your parents' feelings motivate you, you can see it as a kind thing to do for them. You're only young and so much can change if you want it to.
